fields.name: symbol
fields.label: Symbol
fields.description: Term symbol, e.g. P, (APP x CPA), D. For an operator item enter only the operator (=, +, -) and leave Description empty. The first item is the result term (highlighted block).

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: What the symbol stands for. Use one paragraph per meaning, e.g. two paragraphs for (APP x CPA). An item with a description but no symbol is shown as a footnote.

fields.name: split
fields.label: Start a new panel
fields.description: Operator items only: show this operator large, between two separate grey panels.
